subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about driving retained D7 users for {Brand} rather than installs that only look good on day zero. The point worth repeating: we optimise MAFO toward the player still racing on day seven and read that return back through an S2S postback off your MMP, reconciled before it counts. At scale we hold a D7 retention in the 18 to 20 percent band for UK casual racing. I can share the UK retained-D7 cohort view calibrated to your title. Worth a short look?
illustrative_flags: D7 retention in the 18 to 20 percent band for UK casual racing (MobUpps-specific quality signal, illustrative)
register_notes: Stage 1 EN gaming_casual (UK): references prior outreach in first sentence; restates single proof from parent (retained-D7 optimization via S2S postback, MAFO, reconciled before billing); one illustrative MobUpps figure (D7 18-20 percent band); soft CTA, 1 question mark; native UK register; no sign-off; no em-dash; no 'X, not Y'.
